note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All texts are fictional placeholders; jurisdiction unspecified. The two desks are identical except the one changed fact (which words the attributed reading highlights); no winner, score or legal consequence is shown.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: The same fictional passage is traced on two identical desks; reading A highlights "the minutes kept by the secretary", reading B "the register and the minutes kept by the secretary".

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different fictional passage; reading A highlights "before noon", reading B "before noon on working days" (a longer stroke over a different span), with different shared facts and a three-row hierarchy.
